purpose: The OCR-APT (NT2102) demo attack: exploit DVWA (OS command injection -> RCE) from a Kali VM, then run a compact MITRE ATT&CK chain on the target, observable via SilkETW Kernel-Process/File/Network and self-labelled.

attacker.input: the vulnerable web URL (e.g. http://10.21.2.10:3000); the pack is mounted on Kali at /opt/attack-pack (Vagrant)
attacker.note: DVWA's command-injection page (/vulnerabilities/exec/, field 'ip', security=low) is a documented, intentional OS-command sink; the launcher logs in (admin/password), sets security low, and injects '127.0.0.1 & <cradle>'. Override with --exploit-path/--exploit-field if needed.

note: One scenario, custom steps only (no Atomic Red Team dependency). Realistic, deliberately high-volume post-exploitation (scan + tool download + MySQL enumeration + C2 beacon + persistence) so the attack stands out from the idle baseline WITHOUT any detector-side weighting. Whether its window reaches the SG-Det cut-off (Moderate, DEVIATIONS D8) is confirmed on a capture, not tuned to the attack. All lab-only and benign: inert tool markers (not real binaries), read-only DB enumeration, scans of the isolated lab subnets.

scenarios.delivery: Kali exploits DVWA; the RCE shell (httpd.exe -> cmd.exe -> powershell) fetches + runs this script
